maddeler.e:
حققتن (form I)
# حَقَقْتُنَّ (ḥaqaqtunna) /ħa.qaq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa)
# حُقِقْتُنَّ (ḥuqiqtunna) /ħu.qiq.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of حَقَّ (ḥaqqa) and حُقَّ (ḥuqqa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
